protocol_notes.temporal_context: frames1/frames2 are separately trained temporal checkpoints on the same training split; Full is the 3-frame trained checkpoint.
protocol_notes.decoder: Top-1 and posterior-weighted rows change only the front visual anchor; Full preserves the formal front SoftMS.
protocol_notes.other_rows: Other rows are inference/component or sensitivity ablations reusing the Full checkpoint unless the row explicitly says otherwise.
protocol_notes.selection: No nav50/nav51 metric is used to select ablation settings.
protocol_notes.controlled_prior: This remains a controlled local-prior/jitter experiment and must not be described as fully GT-free deployment.
